snippet.title: APPLECALYPSE - TRAILER
snippet.description:
Point and click about apples, featuring real photos as backgrounds, with gameplay sections inspired by billiards and a Lynchian story about a -paranormal?- event taking place in a small town, psychologically and physically transforming the neighborhood’s residents.


STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4316280/APPLECALYPSE/
ITCH: https://pupicrap.itch.io/applecalypse

Music by LIBELLE.
